title: Accidental button presses and nearby-car references
summary: This topic combines mostly unclear references to accidentally pressing the wrong button with a few mentions of steering or moving toward a neighbor’s car, so the examples do not form a single clear issue.

positive.summary: One positive review praises steering-wheel button placement for reducing accidental presses while turning.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention hitting the wrong button, opening something manually with a button, and possible movement toward a neighbor’s car, but the fragments are too incomplete to determine clear sentiment.

limitations: Most examples are fragmentary and lack enough context to determine whether the experience was favorable or unfavorable.
The cluster appears to mix unrelated subjects, including button presses and possible vehicle movement near another car.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all reviews on this topic.
